fieldValues.title: Grid census cycle two and its read-out
fieldValues.summary: A second census of the corpus against the Pattern Grid, diffed against cycle one and actually read, together with the cross-reading of checks.json that shows which cells carry weight with no enforcement. It honours a live kill switch: the ruling said that counts recorded but never read make the operations ritual and cut them.
fieldValues.body: The corpus moved by 10 added and 1 removed out of 229, a 4 percent delta, so cycle one's placements were carried for every surviving statement and only the delta reclassified against the committed rubric. Three readings came out of it: the standard states rules about rules, with conformance and reference holding 121 of 218 placed statements; two of the four unguarded cells are an enforcement gap rather than a coverage gap; and the 20 statements that landed in no cell are two distinct classes rather than one residue.
